findings.title: Northflank status page - initial disclosure and timeline
findings.summary_md: On October 30, 2026 at 11:43 UTC, cloud security firm Wiz sent a threat alert to Northflank. The company posted a status update at 1:40 PM UTC telling all users to rotate environment variables immediately, then at 12:02 UTC applied network policy patches. The page confirms the breach reached stored secrets hosted on the PaaS.

findings.title: Wiz 'Black October' blog - broader AI platform breach pattern
findings.summary_md: Wiz published research on October 30, 2026 documenting at least nine AI developer platforms that disclosed security incidents that month, from Fireworks AI on October 6 through Northflank on October 30. The report notes attackers tested stolen keys against AI endpoints and links the incidents to LLM token abuse and resale markets.
